description: Defines the SpdyHttpStream class, an HTTP-specific stream for SPDY protocol, including its interface, member variables, and related methods.

classes.name: SpdyHttpStream
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP stream over SPDY, handling request registration, stream initialization, data transfer, and stream lifecycle management.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels callbacks and deletes the stream.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request information.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the SPDY stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends the HTTP request headers and prepares to receive response.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads the response headers.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads the response body into a buffer.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally marking it as not reusable.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection was reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Retrieves alternative service info.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the remote endpoint address.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases for the remote endpoint.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns ALPS accept channel info.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Callback when headers are sent.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Callback when early hints are received.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Callback when response headers are received.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Callback when data is received.

methods.name: OnDataSent
methods.description: Callback when data is sent.

methods.name: OnTrailers
methods.description: Callback when trailers are received.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Callback when stream is closed.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if frame type can be greased.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.
